sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Suit pressurization solenoid switch on.
sentences.zh: 宇航服增压电磁阀开启。

sentences.en: Confirmed.
sentences.zh: 收到。

sentences.en: Connect coolant hose.
sentences.zh: 连接冷却软管。

sentences.en: Coolant pump on.
sentences.zh: 冷却泵开启。

sentences.en: Confirmed flaw.
sentences.zh: 确认有瑕疵。

sentences.en: We're going to wait and confirm after suit up.
sentences.zh: 我们等穿好宇航服后再确认。

sentences.en: These guys are about to test a spacesuit.
sentences.zh: 这些人正准备测试一套宇航服。

sentences.en: But this is not a recording of a NASA lab.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是NASA实验室的录音。

sentences.en: This is Cameron Smith's ground floor studio apartment in Portland, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 这是卡梅隆·史密斯在俄勒冈州波特兰市的一楼单间公寓。

sentences.en: That's Julie Sabatier, also from Portland, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 那位是朱莉·萨巴蒂尔，同样来自俄勒冈州波特兰市。

sentences.en: She's a creator of the public radio program and podcast called Destination DIY.
sentences.zh: 她是公共广播节目兼播客《Destination DIY》的创作者。

sentences.en: Do we have to say what DIY stands for?
sentences.zh: 我们有必要解释一下DIY是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It stands for do-it-yourself.
sentences.zh: 它代表“自己动手做”。

sentences.en: You might think building your own spacesuit at home is a little extreme on the DIY spectrum.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得在家自制宇航服在DIY领域里有点极端。

sentences.en: If you do, I totally agree with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你这么想，我完全同意。

sentences.en: It is pretty crazy.
sentences.zh: 这确实挺疯狂的。

sentences.en: We've talked about a lot of kinds of do-it-yourself projects on Destination DIY.
sentences.zh: 我们在《Destination DIY》节目里聊过各种各样的DIY项目。

sentences.en: We have a very broad definition of do-it-yourself.
sentences.zh: 我们对“自己动手做”的定义非常宽泛。

sentences.en: From being your own lawyer to DIY funerals,
sentences.zh: 从自己当律师到DIY葬礼，

sentences.en: way beyond the crafts and home improvement projects that might first spring to mind
sentences.zh: 远远超出了你听到“自己动手做”这几个词时，

sentences.en: when you hear the words, do-it-yourself.
sentences.zh: 脑海中首先浮现出的手工和家居装修项目。

sentences.en: And this is definitely up there with perhaps the most daunting of DIY projects that you could imagine.
sentences.zh: 而这绝对算得上是你所能想象到的最艰巨的DIY项目之一。

sentences.en: Sure, there are commercial companies like Virgin Galactic and X-Core creating their own space gear.
sentences.zh: 当然，像维珍银河和X-Core这样的商业公司也在制造自己的太空装备。

sentences.en: And they are DIY in the sense that they aren't NASA.
sentences.zh: 从它们不是NASA这一点来看，它们也算DIY。

sentences.en: But Cameron Smith is hand-crafting his spacesuit.
sentences.zh: 但卡梅隆·史密斯是在纯手工制作他的宇航服。

sentences.en: Under the suit, I wear a pair of long johns.
sentences.zh: 在宇航服里面，我穿了一件连体长内衣。

sentences.en: I sewed some socks onto them so that they don't slip up on my legs when I push my legs into the pressure suit.
sentences.zh: 我在上面缝了几双袜子，这样当我把腿伸进加压服时，它们就不会往上滑了。

sentences.en: And I sewed, I think I have about 25 feet now, of plastic hose that's sewn into the suit.
sentences.zh: 我还缝了——我想现在大概有25英尺长——塑料软管缝在宇航服里。

sentences.en: And ice water circulates through there, and it keeps me cool.
sentences.zh: 冰水在里面循环，能帮我降温。

sentences.en: And that's absolutely critical.
sentences.zh: 这一点至关重要。

sentences.en: It gets so hot in the suit that you would pass out.
sentences.zh: 宇航服里热得让人会昏过去。

sentences.en: I once had a temperature in there, I think, of 117 degrees.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次里面的温度达到了117华氏度。

sentences.en: But it's really crude.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很简陋。

sentences.en: You should see it.
sentences.zh: 你应该看看它。

sentences.en: You know, I don't have a sewing machine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没有缝纫机。

sentences.en: So I just sit on my bed and I watch a movie or something and just do it by hand.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是坐在床上，一边看电影之类的，一边纯手工缝制。

sentences.en: He's not kidding.
sentences.zh: 他没开玩笑。

sentences.en: The sewing looks like something out of Frankenstein.
sentences.zh: 那缝线看起来就像弗兰肯斯坦的作品。

sentences.en: The second layer of the suit is called the pressure bladder.
sentences.zh: 宇航服的第二层叫做压力囊。

sentences.en: It's basically forming a bubble around Cameron's body to hold the air in.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是在卡梅隆的身体周围形成一个气泡来保持气压。

sentences.en: The third layer goes over that, and that's the pressure restraint layer.
sentences.zh: 第三层覆盖在上面，那是压力约束层。

sentences.en: And that's made of panels of non-elastic mesh.
sentences.zh: 它是由非弹性网格板制成的。

sentences.en: It looks like a cargo bag, sort of.
sentences.zh: 看起来有点像个货运袋。

sentences.en: So those are sewed over the pressure bladder.
sentences.zh: 它们就是这样缝在压力囊外面的。

sentences.en: Because if you were to blow up just the pressure bladder, the suit that contains the gas,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你只给压力囊充气，也就是那个装气体的宇航服，

sentences.en: it blows up into sort of like the Michelin Man.
sentences.zh: 它会膨胀得像米其林轮胎人一样。

sentences.en: And you could survive, but you couldn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 你虽然能活下来，但什么也做不了。

sentences.en: You couldn't bend your arMs.
sentences.zh: 你没法弯曲手臂。

sentences.en: You would be in kind of a spread eagle position, just sort of floating there.
sentences.zh: 你会呈现一种大字型姿势，就那样漂浮着。

sentences.en: You couldn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 你什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Total cost of Cameron Smith's spacesuit, $2,000.
sentences.zh: 卡梅隆·史密斯这套宇航服的总成本是2000美元。

sentences.en: Around one hundredth of one percent of the cost of the latest NASA spacesuit.
sentences.zh: 大约是NASA最新款宇航服成本的万分之一。

sentences.en: This technology over the last 40-odd years has become much cheaper, much more available, and better.
sentences.zh: 在过去40多年里，这项技术变得便宜得多、普及得多，也更好了。

sentences.en: You can essentially build a do-it-yourself space program today, and now, luckily, I'm part of that.
sentences.zh: 你基本上可以在今天建立一个属于自己的太空项目，而现在，幸运的是，我就是其中的一员。

sentences.en: Cameron is not an astronaut.
sentences.zh: 卡梅隆不是宇航员。

sentences.en: He's not even an engineer.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不是工程师。

sentences.en: He's actually an archaeologiSt.
sentences.zh: 他其实是一位考古学家。

sentences.en: He's on faculty in the anthropology department at Portland State University.
sentences.zh: 他是波特兰州立大学人类学系的教员。

sentences.en: But Cameron is an explorer by nature.
sentences.zh: 但卡梅隆天生就是个探险家。

sentences.en: He's been diving in Puget Sound, survived Arctic winters in Iceland and Alaska,
sentences.zh: 他在普吉特海湾潜过水，在冰岛和阿拉斯加熬过了北极的冬天，

sentences.en: and summited Oregon's Mount Hood more times than he can count.
sentences.zh: 登顶俄勒冈州胡德山的次数多到数不清。

sentences.en: The spacesuit is his latest and most ambitious project.
sentences.zh: 这套宇航服是他最新、也是最雄心勃勃的项目。

sentences.en: Showing that it's possible to do it cheaply is, I guess, my part of this larger movement of opening space up to many rather than few.
sentences.zh: 证明低成本实现它是可能的，我想，这就是我为这场让太空向大众而非少数人开放的运动所做的贡献。

sentences.en: The spacesuit has been three years in the making.
sentences.zh: 这套宇航服已经制作了三年。

sentences.en: You only have to look around Cameron's tiny apartment to see how committed he is to this project.
sentences.zh: 你只需要看看卡梅隆那间狭小的公寓，就能看出他为这个项目投入了多少心血。

sentences.en: Instead of hanging art on the wall, Cameron has each of the suit's three layers hanging side by side next to his bed,
sentences.zh: 卡梅隆没有在墙上挂艺术品，而是把宇航服的三层结构并排挂在床边，

sentences.en: which is surrounded by bookshelves crammed full of NASA patents and other research materials.
sentences.zh: 床周围堆满了塞满NASA专利和其他研究资料的书架。

sentences.en: His living room serves as the staging area for the gas canisters and the gondola where he tests the suit.
sentences.zh: 他的客厅成了存放气罐和吊舱的准备区，他在那里测试宇航服。

sentences.en: Eventually, he wants to connect that gondola and all of the life support gear to a balloon that will take him 50,000 feet in the air.
sentences.zh: 最终，他想把那个吊舱和所有的生命维持装备连接到一个气球上，带他升到5万英尺的高空。

sentences.en: He is also sewing the balloon himself.
sentences.zh: 那个气球也是他自己缝的。

sentences.en: At 50,000 feet above the surface of the Earth, Cameron will experience space-like conditions.
sentences.zh: 在地球表面上方5万英尺处，卡梅隆将体验到类似太空的环境。

sentences.en: And that means he'll need his suit to protect him from extreme temperatures and decompression sickness.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他需要宇航服来保护他免受极端温度和减压病的影响。

sentences.en: And that's what you get from going from sea level to high altitude, less pressure, and you decompress.
sentences.zh: 这就是从海平面上升到高空会发生的情况，压力变小，你就会减压。

sentences.en: Your body starts to swell up.
sentences.zh: 你的身体开始肿胀。

sentences.en: Nitrogen bubbles in your tissues start to come out of solution and they give you the bends.
sentences.zh: 组织里的氮气泡开始析出，导致你患上减压病。

sentences.en: It's just what divers get, decompression sickness.
sentences.zh: 这和潜水员得的病一样，就是减压病。

sentences.en: A suit with even three pounds of pressure per square inch can keep a person healthy at high altitude conditions.
sentences.zh: 一套每平方英寸压力仅为3磅的宇航服就能让人在高空环境下保持健康。

sentences.en: And that's just about what Cameron's suit holds on a good day.
sentences.zh: 而这差不多就是卡梅隆的宇航服在状态良好时能维持的压力。

sentences.en: He's worked hard to try to close off all the leaks, but it's an ongoing process.
sentences.zh: 他努力尝试堵住所有的泄漏点，但这依然是一个持续的过程。

sentences.en: And Cameron knows what you think of this.
sentences.zh: 而且卡梅隆知道你是怎么想的。

sentences.en: I really didn't want people to think I was crazy.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想让别人觉得我疯了。

sentences.en: And I was really worried about that because, you know, when you say, oh, a balloon and an open gondola underneath it,
sentences.zh: 我真的很担心这一点，因为你知道，当你提到“哦，一个气球，下面挂着一个敞开的吊舱”，

sentences.en: the first thing people think about is they say, hey, do you remember that guy who went up in a balloon in a lawn chair?
sentences.zh: 人们想到的第一件事就是说，嘿，你还记得那个坐着草坪椅升空的人吗？

sentences.en: Lawn chair Larry, crazy dude.
sentences.zh: “草坪椅拉里”，那个疯子。

sentences.en: That's exactly what people think.
sentences.zh: 人们想到的就是这个。

sentences.en: But not everyone.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都是这样。

sentences.en: Cameron has attracted a small team of student volunteers who are committed to making the technology of space travel more accessible.
sentences.zh: 卡梅隆吸引了一小群学生志愿者，他们致力于让太空旅行技术变得更加普及。

sentences.en: In the spring of 2013, they started doing weekly tests.
sentences.zh: 2013年春天，他们开始进行每周一次的测试。

sentences.en: Shipbox, BG levers, one, two, and three open.
sentences.zh: 船箱，BG杠杆，一、二、三号打开。

sentences.en: BG levers, one, two, and three are open.
sentences.zh: BG杠杆，一、二、三号已打开。

sentences.en: They check off items on an exhaustive list, making sure the breathing gas, pressure gas, and suit coolant are all in place.
sentences.zh: 他们核对清单上的每一项，确保呼吸气体、压力气体和宇航服冷却系统都准备就绪。

sentences.en: The most expensive part of the suit and the only part of the suit that Cameron didn't build himself is the Soviet Air Force helmet he bought on eBay.
sentences.zh: 宇航服最昂贵的部分，也是卡梅隆唯一没有自己制造的部分，是他从eBay上买来的苏联空军头盔。

sentences.en: The helmet is an exception to my general rule of, you know, I want to build it from things that you can easily access
sentences.zh: 这个头盔是我一般原则的一个例外，你知道，我想用容易获取的东西来制造它，

sentences.en: or basically not use things from the production system, typically military production systems that have already sorted out all the probleMs.
sentences.zh: 或者基本上不使用生产系统里的东西，特别是那些已经解决了所有问题的军事生产系统。

sentences.en: I didn't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不想那样做。

sentences.en: I want to solve the problems myself.
sentences.zh: 我想自己解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: I mean, why reinvent the wheel?
sentences.zh: 我是说，为什么要重复发明轮子呢？

sentences.en: These problems have presumably been solved by other people, obviously, because people have been in space before.
sentences.zh: 这些问题大概已经被别人解决了，显然，因为以前已经有人去过太空了。

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: Why reinvent the wheel?
sentences.zh: 为什么要重复发明轮子？

sentences.en: Why redo the...
sentences.zh: 为什么要重做……

sentences.en: It is an incredible thrill for me, personally, to beat my head against a problem and I can't figure it out.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，面对一个难题却想不出解决办法，这是一种难以置信的刺激。

sentences.en: And then one day I'm walking home or I'm on the streetcar and it's a eureka moment.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，我在走路回家或者坐电车时，突然灵光一现。

sentences.en: And it's so thrilling.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉太刺激了。

sentences.en: Ah, I got it!
sentences.zh: 啊，我想到了！

sentences.en: And I have to almost run home and build the thing and see if it works.
sentences.zh: 我几乎得跑回家，把东西做出来，看看它是否有效。

sentences.en: So for me, you know, it's an intellectual adventure.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，你知道，这是一场智力冒险。

sentences.en: It's, oh my gosh, can I figure out the math?
sentences.zh: 那是，天哪，我能算出这个数学题吗？

sentences.en: Can I mix the gases properly?
sentences.zh: 我能正确地混合气体吗？

sentences.en: Can I make this thing hold pressure?
sentences.zh: 我能让这东西保持压力吗？

sentences.en: Can my mind, can I with my mind solve these problems?
sentences.zh: 我的大脑，我能用我的大脑解决这些问题吗？

sentences.en: So it's a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: When Cameron puts the suit on, he starts out on the floor.
sentences.zh: 当卡梅隆穿上宇航服时，他先从地板上开始。

sentences.en: He has to wriggle and shimmy his way into the suit's outer layers.
sentences.zh: 他必须扭动身体，钻进宇航服的外层。

sentences.en: So right now I'll just put my leg up like that and Ben can start getting my foot down in there.
sentences.zh: 现在我先把腿抬起来，本可以开始把我的脚塞进去了。

sentences.en: Ben, I blocked the inhale valve on the ONM.
sentences.zh: 本，我堵住了ONM上的吸气阀。

sentences.en: You can inhale, but you can't exhale.
sentences.zh: 你可以吸气，但没法呼气。

sentences.en: It's a minor problem.
sentences.zh: 这是个小问题。

sentences.en: We will fix it.
sentences.zh: 我们会修好的。

sentences.en: That doesn't sound like a minor problem.
sentences.zh: 听起来不像是个小问题。

sentences.en: What I mean is that the mechanism is so simple that I believe it can be fixed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是这个机制很简单，我相信是可以修好的。

sentences.en: We just haven't got the solution yet.
sentences.zh: 我们只是还没找到解决方案。

sentences.en: It turns out Cameron isn't the only one on the metaphorical floor wriggling into his homemade space suit.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，卡梅隆并不是唯一一个在地板上扭动着钻进自制宇航服的人。

sentences.en: I could actually start a whole new radio show just about the DIYers who are trying to get themselves into space.
sentences.zh: 我其实可以专门开一档广播节目，就讲那些试图把自己送上太空的DIY爱好者。

sentences.en: There's this Danish company called Copenhagen Suborbitals,
sentences.zh: 有一家丹麦公司叫“哥本哈根亚轨道”，

sentences.en: and they're building rockets and space capsules in an abandoned shipyard in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 他们正在丹麦的一个废弃造船厂里制造火箭和太空舱。

sentences.en: One.
sentences.zh: 一。

sentences.en: Two.
sentences.zh: 二。

sentences.en: Six.
sentences.zh: 六。

sentences.en: Five.
sentences.zh: 五。

sentences.en: Four.
sentences.zh: 四。

sentences.en: Tight.
sentences.zh: 紧。

sentences.en: These guys have the goal of suborbital flight in mind, like Alan Shepard.
sentences.zh: 这些人有着和艾伦·谢泼德一样的亚轨道飞行目标。

sentences.en: They'll just go up and come right back down again, rather than orbiting the Earth like John Glenn.
sentences.zh: 他们只是飞上去然后马上回来，而不是像约翰·格伦那样绕地球轨道飞行。

sentences.en: Copenhagen Suborbitals and Cameron Smith, the space suit guy, they've actually been working together.
sentences.zh: “哥本哈根亚轨道”和宇航服达人卡梅隆·史密斯，他们其实一直在合作。

sentences.en: Christian von Banksten is the co-founder of Copenhagen Suborbitals,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安·冯·班克斯滕是“哥本哈根亚轨道”的联合创始人，
zh_words: 克里斯蒂安·冯·班克斯滕

sentences.en: and he's talking to Cameron about building suits for them to use once they're ready to replace their crash test dummy with a live human being.
sentences.zh: 他正在和卡梅隆商谈制造宇航服，以便在他们准备用真人代替碰撞测试假人时使用。

sentences.en: Christian's approach to building his space capsule is right in line with what Cameron is doing with his suit.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安制造太空舱的方法与卡梅隆制造宇航服的方法如出一辙。

sentences.en: A lot of the stuff we're buying is, you know, the Danish equivalent to Home Depot.
sentences.zh: 我们买的很多东西，你知道，都是丹麦版的家得宝。

sentences.en: Take, for example, the heat shields.
sentences.zh: 以隔热罩为例。

sentences.en: NASA has used some pretty fancy materials like reinforced carbon and high-purity silica fiber to create heat shields for the shuttle and other vehicles.
sentences.zh: NASA使用了一些非常高级的材料，比如增强碳和高纯度二氧化硅纤维，为航天飞机和其他飞行器制造隔热罩。

sentences.en: For the space capsule, we have a heat shield made of cork, which is just bought at a local carpet shop.
sentences.zh: 对于太空舱，我们的隔热罩是用软木做的，就是在当地地毯店买的。

sentences.en: Did you say cork?
sentences.zh: 你说软木？

sentences.en: Like C-O-R-K?
sentences.zh: 是C-O-R-K那个软木吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of people find it funny that we use cork as a heat shield, and it might be a bit funny, but it's the perfect solution for it.
sentences.zh: 很多人觉得我们用软木做隔热罩很搞笑，这可能确实有点好笑，但它是完美的解决方案。

sentences.en: What would be the wood-based equivalent of steampunk?
sentences.zh: 如果用木头来类比蒸汽朋克，那该叫什么？

sentences.en: Tree punk, bark punk, wood punk, arbor punk.
sentences.zh: 树木朋克、树皮朋克、木头朋克、乔木朋克。

sentences.en: Arbor punk.
sentences.zh: 乔木朋克。

sentences.en: I like that one.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Anyway, both of these examples may, on the surface, seem as removed as possible from the sleek, polished, and perfectly engineered products of NASA.
sentences.zh: 总之，这两个例子表面上看起来可能与美国国家航空航天局（NASA）那些光滑、精良且完美设计的产物相去甚远。

sentences.en: I mean, their heat shields made out of cork,
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们的隔热罩是用软木做的，

sentences.en: but they all possess the same problem-solving genius needed to allow humans to exist in an environment where no human has any business being.
sentences.zh: 但它们都具备同样的解决问题的天才，而这种天才正是让人类能够在不该存在的地方生存下去所必需的。

sentences.en: One of my favorite scenes in any movie is an Apollo 13,
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的电影片段之一是《阿波罗13号》，

sentences.en: when the ground-based crew realizes that they have to adapt these square carbon dioxide air filters from one part of the ship
sentences.zh: 当时地面指挥中心意识到，他们必须改造飞船上一部分的方形二氧化碳空气过滤器，

sentences.en: to fit into the round carbon dioxide scrubber in another part of the ship, where all the astronauts will asphyxiate and die.
sentences.zh: 使其能装进飞船另一部分的圆形二氧化碳洗涤器里，否则宇航员们都会窒息而死。

sentences.en: What about the scrubbers on the command module?
sentences.zh: 指令舱里的洗涤器怎么办？

sentences.en: They take square cartridges.
sentences.zh: 它们用的是方形滤芯。

sentences.en: The ones on the limb are round.
sentences.zh: 登月舱上的则是圆形的。

sentences.en: Tell me this isn't a government operation.
sentences.zh: 别跟我说这不是政府工程。

sentences.en: It's just isn't a contingency we've remotely looked at.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是我们预想过的应急情况。

sentences.en: Those CO2 levels are going to be getting toxic.
sentences.zh: 二氧化碳浓度很快就会达到中毒水平。

sentences.en: Well, I suggest you gentlemen invent a way to put a square peg in a round hole.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我建议各位先生想办法把方钉塞进圆孔里。

sentences.en: Rapidly.
sentences.zh: 动作要快。

sentences.en: That's the sound of the NASA engineers throwing all the available materials on the spaceship on a table.
sentences.zh: 那是NASA工程师把飞船上所有可用材料扔在桌子上的声音。

sentences.en: Listen up.
sentences.zh: 听好了。

sentences.en: We've got to find a way to make this fit into the hole for this, using nothing but that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须想办法只用这些东西，把这个装进那个孔里。

sentences.en: Let's get it organized.
sentences.zh: 大家分工一下。

sentences.en: Okay, okay, let's build a filter.
sentences.zh: 好，好，我们来做一个过滤器。

sentences.en: Better get some coffee going, too.
sentences.zh: 最好也去煮点咖啡。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 来吧。

sentences.en: So when I think of Cameron, I think less lawn chair Larry, and more 60s engineers sporting the horn rims and the short-sleeved shirt with a tie.
sentences.zh: 所以每当想到卡梅伦，我脑海中浮现的不是那个坐草坪椅的拉里，而是60年代那些戴着黑框眼镜、穿着短袖衬衫打领带的工程师们。

sentences.en: He's scattering the parts across the table and attacking the problem.
sentences.zh: 他把零件散落在桌子上，开始攻克难题。

sentences.en: When I have to design something very specific, and I have to look to how other people have done it if I can't figure it out myself,
sentences.zh: 当我需要设计非常具体的东西，而自己又想不出办法时，我不得不去参考别人的做法，

sentences.en: almost always it's the Russian spacesuits that I'm modeling after.
sentences.zh: 我几乎总是以俄罗斯的宇航服为原型。

sentences.en: They never had as much money, and so they had to do things in a more inventive way.
sentences.zh: 他们的资金从来都不充裕，所以必须用更具创造性的方式来解决问题。

sentences.en: Whether you're in a garage, or at a big company, or in a gondola at 50,000 feet, the design process is the same.
sentences.zh: 无论你是在车库里、大公司里，还是在五万英尺高空的吊篮里，设计过程都是一样的。

sentences.en: For research, express the prototype, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 研究、制作原型、测试、循环改进。

sentences.en: But with Cameron's project, the stakes are significantly higher.
sentences.zh: 但卡梅伦的项目风险要大得多。

sentences.en: It would be so embarrassing to get killed in it, you know, so I'm going to make it work.
sentences.zh: 死在里面太丢人了，你知道吧，所以我一定要让它成功。

sentences.en: Notice that he said embarrassing in that sentence, not terrifying.
sentences.zh: 注意他在那句话里用的是“丢人”，而不是“可怕”。

sentences.en: Which, to me, sounds just like an astronaut.
sentences.zh: 这在我听来，简直就像个宇航员说的话。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Julie Sabatier, creator of the public radio program and podcast Destination DIY.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由朱莉·萨巴蒂尔制作，她是公共广播节目和播客《Destination DIY》的创作者。

sentences.en: The show is currently fundraising on Indiegogo to produce more stories of makers, builders, and offbeat creators.
sentences.zh: 该节目目前正在Indiegogo上筹款，以制作更多关于创客、建造者和非主流创造者的故事。

sentences.en: If you want to pitch in like I did, you can do a search on Indiegogo for Destination DIY or go to DestinationDIY.org.
sentences.zh: 如果你想和我一样出一份力，可以在Indiegogo上搜索“Destination DIY”或者访问DestinationDIY.org。

sentences.en: One of the rewards packages includes a really great set of zines on how to make radio that I think many of you will enjoy.
sentences.zh: 奖励套餐中包括一套非常棒的关于如何制作广播的杂志，我想你们很多人会喜欢的。

sentences.en: The program is Destination DIY.
sentences.zh: 节目名称是《Destination DIY》。

sentences.en: Search for it on Indiegogo.
sentences.zh: 在Indiegogo上搜索它吧。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》的成员有萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼，还有我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7本地公共广播电台KALW和旧金山美国建筑师协会的一个项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注我们的节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是Roman Mars。

sentences.en: Sam tweets at Sam Listens.
sentences.zh: 萨姆的推特账号是Sam Listens。

sentences.en: Avery tweets at Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里的推特账号是Truffleman。

sentences.en: That's the E before the L.
sentences.zh: 那是L之前有个E。

sentences.en: But right now, on our website, we have a couple of really fantastic pictures of Cameron's homemade spacesuit.
sentences.zh: 现在，在我们的网站上，有几张卡梅伦自制宇航服的精彩照片。

sentences.en: It really is a work of art.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: Check it out at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 去99pi.org看看吧。

sentences.en: Radio Tempia.
sentences.zh: 滕皮亚广播电台。
